decision.reason: The computed CRD diff between the v0.37.8 and v1.0.0 manifests [ev-8998581760b8] [ev-451bd6a12e72] shows only a storage-version change (crd:storage-changed). It does not show a removed version. The change text says existing EC2NodeClass objects keep working while stored as v1beta1, and the rewrite is only needed before a later release removes v1beta1. Nothing fails, is rejected or must be migrated for this upgrade, so this is something that works today but will break later: deprecation (review), not migration-required. Confidence is low because the evidence excerpts themselves are empty and the validators were inconclusive.
